lead: Virtual Sundays run on Google Classroom and Google Meet.

students.title: Sign in with your LearnIslam account
students.body: It’s the Google account ending in @learnislam.org. A personal or parent Gmail means waiting while your teacher checks the roster.

students.title: Open the class for the right period
students.body: Each grade has a 1st Period and a 2nd Period class in Google Classroom, each with its own Meet link.

students.title: Click Join next to Meet
students.body: It’s at the top left of the class page. If you see a waiting message, stay on that screen until your teacher lets you in.

students.title: Test by 10:15
students.body: No assembly. Test your connection 10:00–10:15. First period starts at 10:15.

etiquette: Mic muted until it’s your turn

teachers.title: Use your LearnIslam account
teachers.body: The admin creates your classes and adds your students.

teachers.title: Turn on each class’s Meet link (once)
teachers.body: Each grade has a 1st and 2nd Period class, each with its own link. In each: Settings (gear) → scroll to Manage Meet link → generate it, make it visible to students, and Save.

teachers.title: Remind students Saturday
teachers.body: Post in the Stream: “Virtual class tomorrow! Test your connection 10:00–10:15. Join from the Meet link here with your LearnIslam account.”

teachers.title: Open the Meet at 9:50
teachers.body: Start from Classroom and turn on Host controls (shield icon) to mute, manage joining, and remove disruptive students.

teachers.title: Check names before admitting
teachers.body: Personal accounts show as “asking to join”. Admit only names on your roster.

teachers.title: Wrap up
teachers.body: Take attendance from the participants list (People icon in Meet), post homework in Classwork, then End the call for everyone.

troubleshooting.a: Stay on that screen. Your teacher will let you in after checking the roster. Next time, use your @learnislam.org account to get in right away.
Check that the signed-in account (top right) ends in @learnislam.org. If it does and the class is missing, email for help.
Each grade has a 1st Period and a 2nd Period class. Join 1st Period at 10:15, then switch to the 2nd Period class after the break.

troubleshooting.q: Joining from a phone or tablet
troubleshooting.a: Install the Classroom and Meet apps, add the LearnIslam account in each (tap the profile picture), and select it.

troubleshooting.q: No sound, or nobody can hear me
troubleshooting.a: Check you’re unmuted, then ⋮ → Settings → Audio and pick the right microphone and speaker.
